Executive Summary

The Jenkins-Based Research Paper Repository is an academic publication platform engineered with Spring Boot 3.4.3, Java 21 LTS, Spring Data JPA, H2 In-Memory Database, Thymeleaf, and Spring Security 6. It provides a formal, role-governed peer-review lifecycle backed by a multi-stage Jenkins Continuous Integration pipeline, automated Selenium WebDriver end-to-end tests, Docker containerization, and Ansible deployment playbooks.

All 15 development tasks across Phases 1 to 4 have been implemented and verified. The test suite comprises 79 automated tests (76 unit/integration/security tests and 3 headless Chrome Selenium E2E smoke tests) executing with a 100% pass rate.

1. System Architecture & Technical Stack

Layer / Component Technology Version Architectural Purpose & Design Rationale
Core Runtime Java LTS (Eclipse Temurin) 21.0.12.1 Modern pattern matching, record types, virtual threads, LTS baseline.
Backend Framework Spring Boot 3.4.3 Microservice architecture, convention-over-configuration, embedded Tomcat.
Data Persistence Spring Data JPA / Hibernate 6.x Declarative repository queries, schema auto-generation, transaction boundaries.
Database H2 In-Memory Database 2.3.232 Zero-footprint ephemeral relational storage for ultra-fast CI test runs.
Security & RBAC Spring Security 6.x BCrypt password encoding, CSRF protection, 3 roles (researcher, reviewer, admin).
Web Presentation Thymeleaf + Bootstrap 5 5.3.3 Server-side rendering, responsive dark-mode hero cards, WCAG accessibility.
CI Automation Jenkins CI 2.580.1 Declarative pipeline: Checkout, Compile, Test, Package, Archive JAR & JUnit XML.
E2E Browser Testing Selenium WebDriver 4.28.1 Headless Chrome automated user-journey testing and DOM privacy enforcement.
Containerization Docker & Docker Compose Multi-stage Multi-stage container build with non-root runtime on Alpine/Temurin JRE.
Provisioning Ansible Playbook (deploy.yml) Automated host dependency setup, Git cloning, and container lifecycle management.

2. Task-by-Task Implementation Log (Tasks 1 to 15)

Task 1: Environment & Toolchain Verification

Sprint: Week 3 | US-001 | Status: COMPLETED

Proof of Work: Verified JDK 21 Temurin runtime (java -version), Apache Maven wrapper (mvnw.cmd), and Git. Allocated local port 8081 for the Spring Boot application to avoid conflict with Jenkins on port 8080.

Task 2: Spring Boot Scaffolding & Build Verification

Sprint: Week 3 | US-001 | Status: COMPLETED

Proof of Work: Configured pom.xml with web, data-jpa, thymeleaf, validation, and h2 starters. Verified application context bootstrap via passing RepositoryApplicationTests.java (1/1 green).

Task 3: Version Control Baseline & Git Workflow Initialization

Sprint: Week 3 | US-001 | Status: COMPLETED

Proof of Work: Established dual-branch Git baseline (main release branch, development sprint branch) and .gitignore. Synchronized with GitHub remote muawiyah123/Jenkins-Based-Research-Paper-Repository.

Task 4: Public Home & Navigation Portal Scaffold

Sprint: Week 3 | US-001 | Status: COMPLETED

Proof of Work: Created HomeController.java mapping GET / to templates/index.html with responsive Bootstrap 5 hero cards, candidate attribution banner (Muawiyah Narvel, 23108A0020), and 3/3 MockMvc tests in HomeControllerTest.java.

Task 5: Domain Model & In-Memory Persistence

Sprint: Week 4 | US-002 | Status: COMPLETED

Proof of Work: Created Paper.java with 12 attributes (id, title, authors, abstractText, keywords, publicationYear, doiUrl, submitterEmail, submitterUsername, reviewStatus, createdAt, updatedAt), ReviewStatus.java enum, and PaperRepository.java JPA queries with 5/5 passing JPA tests.

Task 6: Research Paper Submission Workflow

Sprint: Week 4 | US-002 | Status: COMPLETED

Proof of Work: Implemented PaperController.java (GET /papers/submit, POST /papers/submit) with Bean Validation constraints (@NotBlank, @Size, @Min, @Max, DOI regex). Submitter username is bound server-side from Authentication.getName() to prevent tampering.

Task 7: Public Catalog & Real-Time Keyword Search

Sprint: Week 5 | US-003, US-004 | Status: COMPLETED

Proof of Work: Built GET /papers and GET /papers/ with multi-column case-insensitive search across title, authors, and keywords. Privacy Compliance: Submitter email is strictly redacted from public views.

Task 8: Paper Metadata Edit & Author Resubmission Workflow

Sprint: Week 5 | US-005 | Status: COMPLETED

Proof of Work: Built GET /papers//edit and POST /papers//edit. Enforces ownership check (only submitter can edit). Editing a paper in REVISIONS_REQUESTED resets status to SUBMITTED; ACCEPTED and REJECTED papers are locked.

Task 9: In-Memory Spring Security 6 Role-Based Access Control (RBAC)

Sprint: Week 6 | US-009 | Status: COMPLETED

Proof of Work: Configured SecurityConfig.java with BCryptPasswordEncoder and 3 development roles: researcher (submit/edit own), reviewer (evaluation queue), admin (all roles + dashboard). CSRF enabled on all state-mutating requests; 12/12 security tests in SecurityConfigTest.java passed.

Task 10: Peer-Review Workflow & 5-State Lifecycle State Machine

Sprint: Week 6 | US-006, US-007 | Status: COMPLETED

Proof of Work: Built reviewer portal (/papers/review, /papers//review, /papers//status). Enforces valid transitions: SUBMITTED → UNDER_REVIEW → ACCEPTED / REJECTED / REVISION_REQUESTED. Verified with 10 unit tests in PaperServiceTest.java.

Task 11: Administrative Metrics Dashboard

Sprint: Week 7 | US-008 | Status: COMPLETED

Proof of Work: Created DashboardController.java mapping to GET /dashboard, rendering live KPI cards: total papers, status distribution counts, acceptance rate, and recent submission logs. Verified with 5/5 MockMvc tests.

Task 12: Input Validation, Error Handling & Comprehensive Test Suite

Sprint: Week 7 | US-010 | Status: COMPLETED

Proof of Work: Custom error pages (403.html, 404.html, 500.html) and full test suite with 76 automated tests passing in 20.7s with 0 failures, 0 errors, 0 skipped.

Task 13: Jenkins CI Declarative Pipeline

Sprint: Week 8 | US-011 | Status: COMPLETED

Proof of Work: Authored declarative Jenkinsfile with 6 stages. Verified with 3 live consecutive successful builds (#1, #2, #3) in local Jenkins controller on port 8080.

Task 14: Automated E2E Smoke Tests with Selenium WebDriver

Sprint: Week 9 | US-012 | Status: COMPLETED

Proof of Work: Implemented PaperSubmissionUiTest.java running Headless Chrome via Maven profile -P e2e with 3/3 passing UI tests validating navigation, table rendering, and email privacy.

Task 15: Containerization (Docker) & Infrastructure Provisioning (Ansible)

Sprint: Weeks 10–11 | US-013, US-014 | Status: COMPLETED

Proof of Work: Created multi-stage Dockerfile with non-root security execution, docker-compose.yml with healthcheck, and Ansible automation files (ansible/inventory and ansible/deploy.yml).

5. Conclusion & Academic Compliance

The Jenkins-Based Research Paper Repository project successfully fulfills all academic, functional, security, and DevOps automation objectives outlined in the 15-task development plan:

  1. Full Academic Lifecycle: Validated submission forms, multi-field catalog search, author editing, 5-state peer-review engine, and admin analytics dashboard.
  2. Security & Privacy: Spring Security 6 RBAC with 3 roles, BCrypt hashing, CSRF protection, and privacy-preserving submitter email redaction.
  3. Continuous Integration: Automated Jenkins pipeline compiling, testing, packaging, and archiving build artifacts with 3 consecutive green builds.
  4. End-to-End Testing: Headless Chrome Selenium test suite validating UI DOM rendering and privacy compliance.
  5. Container & Infrastructure Automation: Production-ready multi-stage Docker containerization and Ansible configuration management.
